concepts.title: The Last Guest
concepts.logline: The majlis empties; the host keeps one gesture for the last guest: the bottle, offered with both hands.
concepts.insight: In the Gulf, the scent you leave a guest with is the last word of your hospitality.

story.payoff: the bottle as the memory of the night

hook.image: A coffee cup set down in silence as the room empties
hook.sound: the soft clink of a coffee cup in an empty room
hook.question: Why is the host still here after everyone left?

product_role.line: The bottle is the gesture that turns a goodbye into hospitality.

concepts.cultural_meaning: Perfuming the last guest is the closing ritual of Gulf hospitality.
concepts.originality_claim: A perfume ad about giving scent, not wearing it.
concepts.differentiator: A human story of hospitality, not a display of luxury.
shot_sketch: one guest lingers at the door
the bottle as the memory of the night

concepts.title: Amber Hour
concepts.logline: Late sun pours through a mashrabiya and turns the bottle's facets into a lattice of gold on the wall.
concepts.insight: A scent is worn like a time of day: some people carry the golden hour with them.

story.turn: the pattern crawls across the room

hook.image: A gold lattice of light sliding across a plaster wall
hook.sound: the creak of a wooden shutter
hook.question: What is the light about to reveal?

product_role.line: The bottle holds the golden hour inside its facets.

concepts.cultural_meaning: The light after asr through the mashrabiya.
concepts.originality_claim: Light as a pattern on the wall instead of a flare on the glass.
concepts.differentiator: Pure light and pattern, no person.
shot_sketch: the pattern crawls across the room
risk_notes: light-only motion may read as static

concepts.title: Wedding Night Walk
concepts.logline: A groom's friends adjust his bisht in a corridor; the final touch before he walks out is the scent.
concepts.insight: The last thing you put on before the biggest night is the one you remember.

hook.image: Many hands fixing one collar in a narrow corridor
hook.sound: many voices in a corridor, then silence
hook.question: What is the last thing they will give him?

product_role.line: The scent is the final touch his friends give before he walks out.

concepts.cultural_meaning: Brothers and friends preparing the groom, hand by hand.
concepts.originality_claim: A wedding seen from the corridor, not the stage.
concepts.differentiator: A milestone moment with a group, built on touch and anticipation.
